narrative.overview: Atoll is a calm, sheltered pool that floats just below the top edge of the screen. Its surface is smoked glass, blurring whatever lies behind it. At rest it is a small, fully rounded pill with Pip the mascot and a single dot. When something happens, the water lights up: an amber, green or coral ring glows around the pill and one short line says what changed. When the user reaches for it, the pill grows smoothly into a rounded panel holding every module side by side.
keyCharacteristics: Floating, fully rounded pill that grows into a 32 px-cornered panel; never attached to the screen edge (8 px gap from the top, from the prototype).
Smoked-glass surfaces with blur(24px) saturate(140%), a 1 px inner hairline and a top highlight.
Status shown by a coloured glow ring plus icon and word, never by colour alone.
Inter at only two weights (400, 600) and six sizes.
Pip appears in every collapsed state and reflects the agent's mood.
Dark and light themes, plus Follow Windows.

rules.name: The Signal-Only Rule
rules.body: Amber, green and coral appear only to report a real state change. Never use them as decoration, illustration colour or brand colour.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status colour is paired with an icon and a word ("Busy", "Done", "Error").

rules.name: The 4.5 Rule
rules.body: Text and status words must reach 4.5:1 on the hull at the current opacity. A custom colour below that is refused with an explanation, never silently applied.

rules.name: The Low-Tide Rule
rules.body: Below 85 % opacity the island adds tinted plates behind headers, cards and buttons, and secondary text switches from Mist to Ink, so legibility never depends on the wallpaper. A collapsed pill that shows text never drops below 85 % opacity.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: Only 400 and 600 exist. No 500, 700, light or italic.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes over time (times, percentages, counts, sizes) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Glow-Means-News Rule
rules.body: A glow ring is a message. If nothing changed, nothing glows.

dos: Do keep the island floating, fully rounded, horizontally centred and 8 px below the top edge.
Do pair every status colour with its icon and word.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or better at every opacity, using the Low-Tide plates below 85 %.
Do use tabular figures for anything that counts or ticks.
Do use exactly the durations in the motion tokens, scaled by the user's animation speed, and replace movement with short fades when Reduce motion is on.
donts: Don't attach the island to the screen edge or square off its top corners.
Don't use amber, green or coral for decoration.
Don't add weights other than 400 and 600, or fonts other than Inter.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing; motion settles, it does not overshoot.
Don't put glass inside glass: cards, rows and controls inside the shell stay flat.
